<!--
  The list footer: a summary line and previous / next page buttons. With `numbered` it shows page numbers (1 … 4
  5 6 … 21), with `moreLabel` a "Load more" button. The current page is a plain element marked
  aria-current="page"; the others are buttons. All text comes in through props.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type PagerProps = {
    page: number;
    pages: number;
    summary: string;
    previousLabel: string;
    nextLabel: string;
    numbered?: boolean;
    pageLabel?: string;
    moreLabel?: string;
    onpage?: (page: number) => void;
    onmore?: () => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import { pageWindow, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    page,
    pages,
    summary,
    previousLabel,
    nextLabel,
    numbered = false,
    pageLabel,
    moreLabel,
    onpage,
    onmore,
  }: PagerProps = $props();
  const numbers = $derived(pageWindow(page, pages));
</script>

<Block
  class={"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground"}
  data-testid="pager"
>
  <Inline class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
    <Inline>
      {summary}
    </Inline>
  </Inline>
  <Inline class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
    {#if (moreLabel && (page < pages))}
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="pager-more" onclick={() => onmore?.()}>
        {moreLabel}
      </Button>
    {/if}
    <Button
      variant="outline"
      size="sm"
      layout="icon"
      aria-label={previousLabel}
      disabled={(page <= 1)}
      onclick={() => onpage?.((page - 1))}
    >
      <LucideIcon name="chevron-left" size={16} />
    </Button>
    {#if numbered}
      {#each numbers as n, i ((n || tpl("gap{0}", i)))}
        {#if (n === null)}
          <Inline class="w-8 text-center">
            {"…"}
          </Inline>
        {:else if (n === page)}
          <Inline
            class={"flex h-8 min-w-8 items-center justify-center rounded bg-foreground px-2 font-bold text-background"}
            aria-current="page"
            data-testid="pager-current"
          >
            {n}
          </Inline>
        {:else}
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            layout="icon"
            type="button"
            aria-label={tpl(pageLabel, n)}
            onclick={() => onpage?.(n)}
          >
            {n}
          </Button>
        {/if}
      {/each}
    {:else}
      <Inline class="min-w-12 text-center font-bold text-foreground">
        {page}
        {" / "}
        {pages}
      </Inline>
    {/if}
    <Button
      variant="outline"
      size="sm"
      layout="icon"
      aria-label={nextLabel}
      disabled={(page >= pages)}
      onclick={() => onpage?.((page + 1))}
    >
      <LucideIcon name="chevron-right" size={16} />
    </Button>
  </Inline>
</Block>
